 For the Petitioner :- Mr. Satyanshu Shubham, Advocate
 For the State :- Mr. Aditya Raman, Advocate

4/06.11.2025
Heard learned counsels for petitioner and for State.

2.  The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Chas PS Case No.359 of 2023, for offence registered under section 406, 408, 419, 420, 379 and 34 of IPC, pending in court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bokaro.
3.
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner was working as Teacher in Swami Sahjanand Saraswati Balika Uchya Vidyalaya, Chas, Bokaro.

entities.text: Swami Sahjanand Saraswati Balika Uchya Vidyalaya
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: He then submits that allegations are made against petitioner that he was working in said school without any B.Ed Certificate.

He next submits that Principal and Secretary of Governing Body of the said school have been granted anticipatory bail in ABA No.10868 of 2023 and ABA No.279 of 2024 and petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as disclosed in paragraph no.12 of petition.
4. Learned State counsel opposes prayer and submits that in absence of any B.Ed certificate the petitioner was working as Teacher in the said school.

entities.text: Rajeshwar Bharti vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering that two of the co-accused have been granted anticipatory bail as aforesaid and the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to petitioner.

6. Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before learned court within three weeks from today, and in event of his surrender/arrest, petitioner, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of like amount each, to satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bokaro, in connection with Chas PS Case No.359 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) 06.11.2025 SI/
